plan.title: Zebrafish drug-exposure DE and pathway enrichment
plan.analytical_narrative: Three treated vs three control zebrafish larvae pools, raw Salmon gene counts on Ensembl D. rerio annotation, single batch, unpaired. Track 1 runs sample-structure QC then a DESeq2 Wald test with apeglm shrinkage to call differentially expressed genes between treated and control, following the grounded procedure for a 3-vs-3 fixed-effect design (minimal pre-filter + independent filtering, BH FDR, explicit reference level, power caveat stated because 3 replicates per group gives low power for anything but large effects). Track 2 takes the differential expression result forward to pathway interpretation: because no zebrafish-native curated pathway collection is staged in this environment, and the DE gene list at typical significance is expected to be short (per the R-0103 rule, an ORA needs at least ~50 significant genes and a ranked GSEA needs a curated collection this environment does not carry for zebrafish), the knowledge-service check rejected preranked GSEA for this organism/enrichment-input combination and approved only over-representation analysis with an explicit universe, run on human-ortholog-mapped genes against the human MSigDB Hallmark and GO Biological Process collections staged in the reference store. This requires an explicit ortholog mapping step (zebrafish Ensembl/symbol -> human ortholog) before enrichment, with the mapped fraction and the resulting caveats reported. A final report step consolidates the DE table, diagnostics, and the enrichment result with all required reproducibility and interpretive caveats.

steps.method: vst(blind), PCA, sample distances, library sizes
Keep gene with >=10 counts in >= smallest group size (3)
apeglm shrinkage on the treated vs control coefficient
fgsea preranked GSEA on the Wald statistic using human-ortholog-mapped Hallmark and GO-BP gene sets (via org.Dr.eg.db / babelgene ortholog mapping)
Report with power caution, MA/dispersion plots, leading edge genes, annotation/ortholog mapping details
fgsea preranked GSEA on the Wald statistic using human-ortholog-mapped Hallmark gene sets (org.Dr.eg.db / babelgene ortholog mapping), reporting the mapped share and stating the organism limit

Over-representation analysis (clusterProfiler enricher) with an explicit universe of tested genes, on zebrafish genes mapped to human orthologs (org.Dr.eg.db / babelgene), against MSigDB Hallmark and GO-BP gene sets
